LESSON: HADITH OF PROPHET MUHAMMAD AS A MODEL OF GOOD CHARACTER.

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith
Topic 2.1: Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are the character traits of a good child?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the selected hadith on the character of the Prophet as a role model

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read the selected hadith on the character of the Prophet as a role model
   In simple words: practise until you can read the selected hadith on the character of the Prophet as a role model. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. in the examples.
2. Explain Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
4. Show that you can: read the selected hadith on the character of the Prophet as a role model

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read the hadith: “I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals.” (Narrated by Al-Hakim),
2. Discuss ways in which Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) is a model of good character (trustworthy, truthful, kind, and generous) and present in class,
3. Role-play character traits of the Prophet,
4. Digital literacy: the skill of connecting using digital technology is enhanced through use of digital devices to listen to the story of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W). Values:
5. Respect: is enhanced as learners listen attentively to the story of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) from a digital device/teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the character traits of a good child?
2. What were the character traits of Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) as a youth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the selected hadith on the character of the Prophet as a role model

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
